checkout.signInFirst: Your session here ended. If you have a Pro plan, sign in and this tool is included at no charge. To buy it without signing in, press the button again.

code.instead: Email me a sign-in code instead
code.invalid: That code didn't work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
code.label: Code from the email
code.onItsWay: If this address can sign in, check your email for a link (or a 6-digit code). Either one signs you in. It usually arrives within a minute.
code.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s.
code.stillNothing: Still nothing? Check your spam folder, or email
code.tooShort: Enter the whole code from the email.

confirm.body: Press Continue to finish signing in. The link works once.
confirm.emailChangeBody: Press Continue to confirm your new email address.
confirm.emailChanged: Your email change is confirmed. If your other address also received a link, use that one too.
confirm.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Sign in again to get a new one.
confirm.recoveryBody: Press Continue to choose a new password.
confirm.title: Finish signing in
confirm.unreachable: We couldn't reach the sign-in server. Check your connection and try again; the link is still valid.

auth.confirmationOnItsWay: If this address can sign in, a confirmation email is on its way. It usually arrives within a minute.

create.offer: New here? You can create an account for {{email}} with this password.
create.refused: We couldn't create an account with that email and password.
create.tooShort: A new account needs a password of at least 8 characters.

auth.footnote: An account keeps your scores, credits and purchases, and a CV only if you save one.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

guard.passwordCleared: We cleared a password set on this address before you proved you own it. Set a new one in your account settings if you want one.
guard.signedOut: We cleared a password set on this address before you proved you own it, and that signed out every device, this one too.

linkCheck.body: This link signs in to the account below. This browser didn't ask for it, so nothing is signed in until you say so.
linkCheck.cancelled: Nothing was signed in. If you meant to sign in, ask for a new link from the sign-in page.
linkCheck.title: Is this your account?

auth.mismatch: We couldn't sign you in with that email and password.
auth.notConfirmed: This address isn't confirmed yet. Use the link in the confirmation email (it may be in spam).

provider.failed: That sign-in didn't finish. Try again, or use your password.

auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

reset.blocked: We couldn't confirm this address just now, so no password was set. Try again in a few minutes, or email
reset.doneOthers: Your new password is set, and every other device was signed out.
reset.intro: Enter your email. If it has an account, we'll email a link (or a 6-digit code) you can use to choose a new password.
reset.onItsWay: If an account exists for this address, check your email for a link (or a 6-digit code). Either one lets you choose a new password. It usually arrives within a minute.
reset.proven: This address is confirmed. Choose a new password.
reset.refused: We couldn't confirm this address with that link or code, so no password was set. Ask for a new reset link, or email support.
reset.signedIn: You're signed in. You can change your password in your account settings.
reset.signedOut: For your security every device was signed out. Ask for a new code to finish.
reset.title: Reset your password

return.failed: Sign-in didn't finish. Please try again.

auth.samePassword: Choose a password you haven't used here before.
auth.sendFailed: We couldn't send that just now. Try again in a minute, or email {{support}}.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign back in to pick up where you left off.
auth.subtitle: Track your CV scores over time, keep your scan history, and see your credits and purchases in one place. Free forever.
auth.title: Sign in or create your free account
auth.weakPassword: That password is too weak or too common. Use at least 8 characters that are hard to guess.
